work_package: S1-WP4 — Gate artifacts with persisted validation
ending_worktree_state: dirty; only scoped S1-WP4 implementation, tests, report and baton changes are uncommitted; ignored generated appshak_state remains ignored
objective: Persist artifact integrity, structured acceptance criteria and independent validation so only proven acceptance can complete a durable owner task.
artifact_contract: New file artifacts retain UUID, task, producing attempt, canonical path, kind, producer, workspace, size, SHA-256 and creation time; reference is distinct from validation.
acceptance_contract: Owner-defined, pre-execution structured FILE_EXISTS, EXACT_TEXT and SHA256 criteria persist with UUID, required flag and owner/source attribution.
completion_gate: Only a persisted PASSED run covering all required criteria with producer/observed/completion integrity equality transitions VALIDATING to COMPLETE. Execution success and artifact existence stop at READY_FOR_VALIDATION.
validator_behavior: Named deterministic validator independently reads the artifact through an authorized WP2 READ_FILE attempt and persists per-criterion evidence; it never trusts producer or model success claims.
integrity_binding: Producer and validator SHA-256/size are persisted; completion recomputes current bytes and requires all three views to match. Mutation before completion fails validation.
persistence_changes: Existing SQLite substrate stores artifact integrity, acceptance criteria, validation runs/checks and task history transactionally; no second database.
schema_changes: Extended owner_task_artifacts and execution_attempts; added task_acceptance_criteria, validation_runs and validation_checks; idempotent migration preserves WP3 rows.
failure_behavior: Checked mismatch becomes FAILED and task VALIDATION_FAILED with criterion/integrity evidence; no completion or repair dispatch.
error_behavior: Read/tool error becomes ERROR/VALIDATION_ERROR; uncertain or expired validator attempt becomes NEEDS_RECONCILIATION and cannot pass or replay blindly.
repair_policy: No automatic repair and no automatic validation or production retry policy.
restart_status: PASS — pending/terminal validation and COMPLETE persist; running work reconciles from its WP2 attempt without silent rerun.
golden_pass_status: PASS — real write, integrity artifact, authorized independent read, deterministic PASS, COMPLETE and restart persistence demonstrated.
golden_fail_status: PASS — wrong content produces durable FAILED/VALIDATION_FAILED evidence and remains not complete after restart.
authority_continuity_status: PASS — validator attempt retains task, authority, source, worker, workspace, operation, validation and attempt IDs; ToolGateway checks remain active.
execution_recovery_status: PASS — WP2 lease/fence, timeout, crash, duplicate and unknown semantics pass; lease renewal now spans the entire tool call to protect outcome persistence under Windows cleanup latency.
task_contract_status: PASS — WP3 identity, assignment, attempt linkage, FAILED versus unknown and no-retry semantics remain passing; COMPLETE is introduced only behind validation PASS.
tests_added: tests/test_s1_wp4_persisted_validation.py: 15 focused tests covering requested tests 1-15; test 16 is the full regression gate
tests_run: python -m py_compile on changed Python files
nonblocking_findings: WP4 validates UTF-8 local file artifacts only; it is not a general artifact or CI registry.
Legacy WP3 artifact rows are preserved but lack WP4 integrity metadata and cannot be validated as new records.
Persisted evidence remains bound to the completed digest, but WP4 does not continuously detect later external file mutation or automatically demote COMPLETE.
The existing .gitignore ignores .appshak/; BATON-0006 exists but needs explicit force-staging in the later checkpoint.
